interpretation: Coverage-cell level: format, construct (plain/transform/include), edge direction, and additional contract dimensions are distinct cells; a case is a duplicate only when every dimension and value pair of an asserted pilot cell are identical. A post-run audit flags g049 and g052 as re-asserting the pilot t04 VCF index cell (none -> tbi) with a different compression context; g048 reverses b07's index pair (a distinct edge direction, consistent with the pilot's b09/b31 direction precedent); g066 adds sort/index/build dimensions and is distinct. PR-02 section 0.2 forbids post-outcome exclusion, so the sealed N=83 set is the primary analysis; these are descriptive sensitivity analyses only.
